newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India cancels tender to buy Nov 16-20 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India cancels tender to buy Nov 16-20 fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has cancelled a tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil for delivery November 16-20, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender sought 25,000 tonnes of 3.5 percent sulphur grade, 180 centistoke fuel oil for delivery to Bombay/Kandla, on the west coast of India.
The tender was due to close on October 31 and was valid until November 1.

Sources said India's tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of the same grade of fuel oil issued on Monday for delivery between November 15-18 remained valid. The tender will also close on October 31 and is valid until November 1.

IOC had sought for three cargoes in total for November delivery. On Monday, it bought one 25,000 tonne-cargo for delivery November 6-10 at $13.50 per tonne over Mideast quotes on a cost-and-freight basis to Bombay.
